sourceCopy.name: Weekly Planner
sourceCopy.title: Weekly Planner Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Plan a weekly schedule, spot overlapping time blocks, and print or back up your plan. Free, with no account.
sourceCopy.intro: Build a simple weekly time-block schedule for work, personal plans, study, or health. Overnight blocks and schedule conflicts are shown clearly.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I make a weekly schedule?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Add a title, day, start time, end time, and category for each block. Blocks can cross midnight. Overlapping time is flagged, including across Sunday and Monday.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Is my weekly schedule uploaded or saved?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Your schedule stays in this browser tab unless you choose to download a JSON backup. Import a backup you selected from your device.

additionalFaqs.question: Can a weekly planner include overnight shifts?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Choose an end time earlier than the start time to create a block that ends the next day. Blocks up to 18 hours are supported.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the weekly schedule detect conflicts?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. It checks time blocks on the same day and across midnight, including a Sunday block that overlaps Monday.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this planner sync with Google Calendar?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It works locally in this tab and has no calendar connection or reminder service. You can print the plan or download and import a JSON backup.
